narr: A moist air mass was in place with dew points generally in the mid 70s on July 22, 2024. This resulted in heavy rain and localized flooding across portions of eastern and southeastern Virginia.
ev: The public reported flooded roads on Waze in the City of Hampton.
A trained spotter reported that the intersection of Plum Street and Madison Avenue was flooded and impassible.
